items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: No, I never met Bix. Bix Buderbecke?

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Speaking of that, did you know many of the -- I'm sure you did -- of the -- oh, the old Chicago gang. Of course, they were late '20's more so, but I'm thinking of, well, even Bix. Did you ever meet him?
No, I never met Bix. Bix Buderbecke?
